description: This file implements functions and classes related to HTTP alternative services, including histogram logging, validation, and processing of alternative service entries, specifically for protocols like HTTP/2 and QUIC within the Chromium project.

classes.name: AlternativeServiceInfo
classes.description: Represents information about an alternative service, including protocol, host, port, expiration, and supported QUIC versions.

classes.name: AlternativeService
classes.description: Represents an alternative service with protocol, host, and port, and provides string serialization.

methods.name: HistogramAlternateProtocolUsage
methods.description: Logs histogram data for alternate protocol usage, differentiating Google hosts.

methods.name: HistogramBrokenAlternateProtocolLocation
methods.description: Logs histogram data for locations where alternate protocols are broken.

methods.name: IsAlternateProtocolValid
methods.description: Checks if a given protocol is valid for use as an alternate protocol.

methods.name: IsProtocolEnabled
methods.description: Determines if a protocol is enabled based on feature flags.

methods.name: AlternativeServiceInfo::CreateHttp2AlternativeServiceInfo
methods.description: Creates an AlternativeServiceInfo object for HTTP/2.

methods.name: AlternativeServiceInfo::CreateQuicAlternativeServiceInfo
methods.description: Creates an AlternativeServiceInfo object for QUIC.

methods.name: AlternativeService::ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the alternative service.

methods.name: AlternativeServiceInfo::ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the alternative service info, including expiration.

methods.name: operator<<
methods.description: Outputs an AlternativeService to an output stream.

methods.name: ProcessAlternativeServices
methods.description: Processes a list of alternative service entries, filtering and converting them into internal representations.
